alerts.fraudTitle: Application Flagged as Fraud / Counterfeit Scale
alerts.fraudDesc: The assigned Inspector has flagged discrepancies in your submitted documentation or scale specification plate. Under Section 30 of the Legal Metrology Act 2009, visit scheduling is prohibited.
alerts.fraudButton: Visit Scheduling Blocked: Discrepancy Flagged by Enforcement Officer
alerts.underVerificationDesc: Your 5 statutory documents have been submitted to {{inspector}}. Once the officer marks them Verified, appointment confirmation will be unlocked.
alerts.awaitingInspector: Awaiting Enforcement Officer Allocation by Department Admin
alerts.awaitingInspectorDesc: Your store {{store}} has been registered. The Department Admin / Controller will assign a designated Legal Metrology Officer to your jurisdiction. Once assigned, you can submit the 5 statutory documents for officer review.
alerts.docsApprovedDesc: Verified by {{reviewer}}. You are now authorized to schedule your verification window.
alerts.fraudNoticeDoc: Official Rejection Notice • Legal Metrology Act 2009
alerts.fraudDocDesc: The Inspector flagged a discrepancy between the uploaded instrument plate and manufacturer serial database. Visit scheduling is blocked by Department order. Please visit the Controller's office for inquiry.
alerts.certSuspendedDesc: Commercial scale at {{shop}} has failed Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) tolerance tests or has broken physical wire-seals.
alerts.auditDiscrepancyDesc: Physical audit by Legal Metrology Officer revealed a calibration variance exceeding statutory MPE Tolerance limit. Official wire seal was reported broken or unverified.
alerts.uncertifiedPenalty: Using uncertified scales in commercial trade is punishable under law. Please request a re-calibration inspection immediately.
